rulesStrings.li: vox_WarDeclared->[FACTION_A] and [FACTION_B] at each other's throats. Again. I'm starting to think it's a hobby.
vox_WarDeclared->War between [FACTION_A] and [FACTION_B]. Somebody remind me which one owes us silver.
vox_WarDeclared->If [FACTION_A] wins, we're neighbours with a winner. That's never good.
vox_WarDeclared->I give it a season. Two if [LEADER_A] is as stubborn as they say.
vox_WarDeclared->Every war out there means more raiders down here. Check the sandbags.
vox_WarDeclared->I hope they both lose. Is that allowed?
vox_WarDeclared->Someone get the map out. I want to know how far away this is.
vox_WarDeclared->War is just trade by other means. Worse means.
vox_WarDeclared->[FACTION_B] never saw it coming. Neither did I, to be fair.
vox_WarDeclared->First the drums, then the refugees, then the raiders. You watch.
vox_WarDeclared(US==yes)->They declared war on US? On our little [COLONY]? Bold.
vox_WarDeclared(US==yes)->Well. Now we're in the paper for the wrong reasons.
vox_WarDeclared(US==yes)->Everyone to the walls. And someone tell the cook to stop crying.
vox_WarDeclared(US==yes)->War with [FACTION_A]. I knew that trader was looking at our turrets too long.
vox_WarDeclared(TONE==callous)->Good. Let them bleed each other. Less for us to deal with.
vox_WarDeclared(TONE==callous)->Finally. I was getting bored.
vox_WarDeclared(TONE==kind)->All those families. I can't stop thinking about the families.
vox_WarDeclared(TONE==greedy)->Both sides will need steel and medicine. We have steel and medicine.
vox_WarDeclared(TONE==grim)->This is how it starts. Then it's everyone. Then it's us.
vox_WarDeclared(TONE==sunny)->Maybe it'll be short! Wars are sometimes short. Right?
vox_PeaceMade->Peace between [FACTION_A] and [FACTION_B]. I'll believe it when the caravans start running.
vox_PeaceMade->Good. Fewer bodies on the roads means fewer bodies on our doorstep.
vox_PeaceMade->Peace! Someone open the good beer. Not the very good beer. The good beer.
vox_PeaceMade->They'll be at it again within the year. But tonight, peace.
vox_PeaceMade->I wonder who blinked first. My bet's on [FACTION_A].
vox_PeaceMade->The traders will be back. And they'll want to talk about it for hours.
vox_PeaceMade->Peace treaties are only as good as the people who sign them. Let's see.
vox_PeaceMade->Maybe now the refugees can go home.
vox_PeaceMade(US==yes)->We're at peace with [FACTION_A]? Then who do I glare at from the wall?
vox_PeaceMade(US==yes)->Peace with [FACTION_A]. I'll keep my rifle oiled anyway.
vox_PeaceMade(TONE==callous)->Shame. I was enjoying the reports.
vox_PeaceMade(TONE==kind)->Finally some good news. I could cry.
vox_PeaceMade(TONE==greedy)->Peace is bad for the arms trade. Good for everything else, I suppose.
vox_JoinedWar->[FACTION_A] jumping into the fight. More's the merrier, if you're an undertaker.
vox_JoinedWar->Allies dragging allies in. This is how small wars become big ones.
vox_JoinedWar->Now it's a proper mess. Pick a side? No thanks.
vox_JoinedWar->One more flag on the battlefield. One less faction to trade with.
vox_BattleFought->A battle near [DETAIL]. I hope the medics are better than ours.
vox_BattleFought->They say [FACTION_A] carried the day. They always say that about whoever wrote the report.
vox_BattleFought->Hundreds fighting over one town. We fight over who does the dishes.
vox_BattleFought->Battles mean bodies, and bodies mean scavengers. Watch the roads.
vox_BattleFought->I'd like to know what they're using. Charge rifles? Spears? Both?
vox_BattleFought->Somewhere a doctor is very, very tired.
vox_BattleFought(TONE==callous)->Wish I'd been there. Do they take volunteers?
vox_BattleFought(TONE==kind)->There are people dying in the mud over this. Real people.
vox_SettlementOccupied->[FACTION_A] holds [DETAIL] now. The people there didn't get a vote.
vox_SettlementOccupied->New flag over [DETAIL]. Same mud underneath.
vox_SettlementOccupied->If they can take a town like that, they can take a colony like ours. Just saying.
vox_SettlementOccupied->Occupied. I hope the new masters at least fix the roads.
vox_SettlementOccupied->[FACTION_B] won't forget [DETAIL]. Nobody forgets a lost town.
vox_SettlementReturned->[DETAIL] is back where it belongs. Somebody's very relieved tonight.
vox_SettlementReturned->Taken, retaken. The people of [DETAIL] must be exhausted.
vox_SettlementReturned->Good for them. Nobody likes living under someone else's flag.
vox_CapitalLost->[FACTION_B] lost their capital. That's not a defeat, that's a disaster.
vox_CapitalLost->Imagine waking up and your capital belongs to someone else.
vox_CapitalLost->Without a capital, who even runs [FACTION_B] now?
vox_CapitalLost->That's the sort of news that changes maps. And not in pencil.
vox_CapitalLost->If [CAPITAL_A] can fall, anything can.
vox_CapitalEstablished->[FACTION_A] has a new capital at [CAPITAL_A]. Fancy.
vox_CapitalEstablished->New capital, new taxes. That's how it always goes.
vox_CapitalEstablished->A capital is just a town with a bigger opinion of itself.
vox_Capitulation->[FACTION_B] gave up. Can't say I blame them.
vox_Capitulation->Surrender. The hardest word for any leader. [LEADER_A] must be pleased with themselves.
vox_Capitulation->The war's over, for them at least. Now comes the bill.
vox_Capitulation->Losers pay. They always pay.
vox_PeaceTerms->Peace terms. A polite word for 'give us your stuff'.
vox_PeaceTerms->Reparations, land, apologies. I'd have asked for pie.
vox_PeaceTerms->The winners write the terms, the losers write the history. Wait, that's not right.
vox_Blockade->A blockade. Nobody in, nobody out. I'd go mad.
vox_Blockade->They're starving them out. Slow, ugly and it works.
vox_Blockade->No caravans through. Prices will jump everywhere, you watch.
vox_SiegeBegan->A siege at [DETAIL]. I hope they have a good well.
vox_SiegeBegan->Sieges are the worst. All waiting and no glory.
vox_SiegeBegan->The defenders of [DETAIL] are in for a long, hungry season.
vox_SiegeBegan->If anyone ever besieges us, I want it known that I called dibs on the chocolate.
vox_SiegeBegan(US==yes)->Someone's besieging us? Lock the freezer!
vox_WarbandMarching->A warband on the march. Let's hope it's marching somewhere else.
vox_WarbandMarching->Fighters moving through the hills. Keep the animals in tonight.
vox_WarbandMarching->Where are they headed? I'd really like to know where they're headed.
vox_WarbandMarching->Warbands don't march for fun. Somebody's about to have a bad week.
vox_WarbandMarching(US==yes)->That warband is heading our way. Everyone get your armour on. Yes, now.
vox_WarbandIntercepted->Caught them on the road. Ambush beats a fair fight every time.
vox_WarbandIntercepted->So much for the big march.
vox_Reinforcements->Reinforcements. Because one army wasn't enough.
vox_Reinforcements->More soldiers, more mouths to feed, more trouble.
vox_BorderSkirmish->A skirmish on the border. That's how wars clear their throat.
vox_BorderSkirmish->Shots across the border. Somebody will call it an accident. Nobody will believe them.
vox_BorderSkirmish->Small fights become big fights. I've seen it before.
vox_MissileStrike->Missiles. Actual missiles. We're not ready for missiles.
vox_MissileStrike->Did anyone feel that? No? Good. Let's keep it that way.
vox_MissileStrike->Whoever fires missiles first never fires them last.
vox_MissileStrike->That's a crater where a town used to be. Let that sink in.
vox_MissileStrike->We need a deeper basement. Much deeper.
vox_MissileStrike(TONE==grim)->I've never seen a mushroom cloud. I would like to keep it that way.
vox_ArmsRace->Everyone's building more guns. Wonderful. Very reassuring.
vox_ArmsRace->Arms race. Which means someone's going to want to try them out.
vox_ArmsRace->More weapons in the world, and none of them are ours.
vox_ColdWarBegan->Nobody's shooting yet. That's the scary part.
vox_ColdWarBegan->A cold war. Lots of glaring, lots of spies, lots of nerves.
vox_ColdWarBegan->They hate each other but won't say it with bullets. Yet.
vox_ColdWarEnded->The cold war's over. Everyone can stop glaring now.
vox_ColdWarEnded->Thaw. Took them long enough.
vox_ProxyWar->They fund someone else to do the fighting. Cowards, the lot of them.
vox_ProxyWar->Proxy war. Somebody else's sons dying for someone else's grudge.
vox_RelationsWarmed->[FACTION_A] and [FACTION_B] are friends now. Friends who might gang up on someone.
vox_RelationsWarmed->An alliance. Good for them. Hopefully not bad for us.
vox_RelationsWarmed->Two factions holding hands. Watch where they point next.
vox_RelationsWarmed->Allies today, rivals tomorrow. That's the rim.
vox_AllianceBroken->Allies no more. Someone said something they shouldn't have.
vox_AllianceBroken->Broken alliance. That's a lot of awkward dinners cancelled.
vox_AllianceBroken->When friends fall out, the knives come out quicker.
vox_AllianceBroken->I always said [FACTION_A] couldn't be trusted. I say that about everyone, but still.
vox_TreatySigned->A treaty. Lots of signatures, lots of seals, lots of promises.
vox_TreatySigned->Signed and sealed. Let's see if it's kept.
vox_TreatySigned->Paper's cheap. Keeping your word is expensive.
vox_TreatySigned->Good. Rules are better than raids.
vox_TreatySigned(US==yes)->We signed something? I hope someone read it first.
vox_TreatyBroken->A broken treaty. Nobody will trust [FACTION_A] for years.
vox_TreatyBroken->They broke it. Of course they broke it.
vox_TreatyBroken->A promise on paper is still just a promise.
vox_TreatyCancelled->Cancelled. Sometimes the polite way out is still a slammed door.
vox_TreatyCancelled->No more treaty. No more pretending.
vox_TreatyExpired->Ran out quietly. Nobody bothered to renew it. That says something.
vox_TreatyExpired->Expired. Like the milk.
vox_EmbargoDeclared->An embargo. So the price of everything goes up again.
vox_EmbargoDeclared->No trading with [FACTION_B]. Someone's going to smuggle, mark my words.
vox_EmbargoDeclared->Embargoes hurt the poor first. Always.
vox_EmbargoDeclared->Good luck enforcing that. Traders find a way.
vox_EmbargoDeclared(US==yes)->They won't trade with us? Fine. We'll trade with their neighbours. At a markup.
vox_EmbargoDeclared(TONE==greedy)->An embargo means a smuggling market. A very profitable smuggling market.
vox_EmbargoLifted->Trade's open again. Finally.
vox_EmbargoLifted->Embargo lifted. Prices should come back down. Eventually. Maybe.
vox_BordersChanged->Borders opening, borders closing. Lines on a map, getting moved by people who never walk them.
vox_BordersChanged->So we can't go there now? Or we can? I've lost track.
vox_Denounced->Denounced. Fancy word for a public telling-off.
vox_Denounced->[FACTION_A] said rude things about [FACTION_B]. In public. With a podium.
vox_Denounced->Words now, swords later.
vox_TributePaid->Tribute. Paying someone not to hurt you. Nice work if you can get it.
vox_TributePaid->Silver flowing uphill, as usual.
vox_DelegationDispatched->Diplomats on the road. Let's hope they don't get eaten by a thrumbo.
vox_DelegationDispatched->An envoy. Which means someone wants something.
vox_DelegationDispatched->They're sending fancy people in fancy clothes. Must be serious.
vox_DelegationIntercepted->Someone ambushed a delegation. That's not diplomacy, that's a declaration.
vox_DelegationIntercepted->Attacking envoys. Even raiders usually draw the line there.
vox_DelegationIntercepted->Whatever they were going to sign, it's not getting signed now.
vox_DelegationIntercepted(US==yes)->That was us. I'm not sorry.
vox_DelegationIntercepted(US==yes)->We ambushed envoys? Well, they had it coming. Probably.
vox_SummitHeld->A summit. Lots of talking, lots of eating, maybe some agreeing.
vox_SummitHeld->Leaders in one room. I'd pay to hear what was said.
vox_SummitHeld->Good. Talking is cheaper than fighting.
vox_SummitFailed->The summit fell apart. Shocking. Nobody's shocked.
vox_SummitFailed->They couldn't even agree on the seating.
vox_SummitFailed->Failed talks are worse than no talks. Now they've seen each other's faces.
vox_HostagesExchanged->Hostages home. Somebody's mother is very happy tonight.
vox_HostagesExchanged->Swapping people like trade goods. What a world.
vox_EnvoyMission->Our envoy made it. Let's hope they behaved.
vox_EnvoyMission->Diplomacy by caravan. Very civilised.
vox_EnvoyCaptured->They took our envoy. That's not how this works.
vox_EnvoyCaptured->Captured? Then we go and get them back.
vox_VisitIncident->A visit gone wrong. Someone said the wrong thing to the wrong guard.
vox_VisitIncident->Visitors and trouble go together like muffalo and mud.
vox_VassalOutpostGained->Another outpost under someone's thumb.
vox_VassalOutpostGained->Vassals. A polite word for 'owned'.
vox_VassalOutpostLost->Lost an outpost. Things fall apart at the edges first.
vox_VassalOutpostLost->One less flag on the frontier.
vox_FactionAbsorbed->Swallowed whole. One faction fewer on the map.
vox_FactionAbsorbed->They didn't lose a war, they lost their name. That's worse.
vox_CallToArmsRefused->Asked for help and got a shrug. Remember that next time they ask.
vox_CallToArmsRefused->Allies who don't show up aren't allies.
vox_FederationCharter->A federation charter. Big words. Big hopes.
vox_FederationCharter->If they can hold this together, the rim might actually change.
vox_FederationJoined->Another member for the federation. It's growing.
vox_FederationJoined->Strength in numbers. Or squabbles in numbers.
vox_FederationLeft->Walking out of the federation. That'll sting.
vox_FederationLeft->Unity lasted about as long as I expected.
vox_FederationProclaimed->A planetary federation. I never thought I'd see it.
vox_FederationProclaimed->History. Actual history. And I was cleaning the freezer when it happened.
vox_CouncilConvened->Another council session. More speeches, fewer results.
vox_CouncilConvened->They're meeting again. Bring snacks.
vox_CouncilConvened->Everybody in one hall, all pretending to like each other.
vox_DecreePassed->A new decree. I'll obey it if I understand it.
vox_DecreePassed->Passed! Now we see who actually follows it.
vox_DecreePassed->Rules for everyone, except whoever wrote them.
vox_MotionRejected->Voted down. Democracy, or something like it.
vox_MotionRejected->Rejected. Somebody's sulking tonight.
vox_DecreeViolated->Broke the decree already? That didn't take long.
vox_DecreeViolated->Rules are only rules when someone enforces them.
vox_DecreeExpired->Expired. Like most good intentions.
vox_DecreeExpired->And just like that, it's over.
vox_LeaderDied->[FACTION_A]'s leader is dead. Now comes the scramble.
vox_LeaderDied->Dead leaders leave empty chairs, and empty chairs start fights.
vox_LeaderDied->I wonder who's next in line. I wonder if they're worse.
vox_LeaderDied->Rest in peace, I suppose. Even leaders deserve that much.
vox_LeaderDied->Funerals for leaders are always the most crowded. Half are there to make sure.
vox_LeaderDied(TONE==callous)->One less tyrant. Or one less hero. Depends who you ask.
vox_Riots->Riots in [FACTION_A]. Something's very wrong over there.
vox_Riots->When people riot, it's never just about bread. But it's usually about bread.
vox_Riots->Burning shops, broken windows, angry crowds. Glad I'm here.
vox_Riots->I'd riot too if they served what our cook makes.
vox_Riots->Hungry people, angry people. Same thing, really.
vox_Riots(TONE==sunny)->Riots! Our cook had better watch it.
vox_Riots(TONE==kind)->Hope nobody got hurt. Well, too late for that.
vox_Coup->A coup in [FACTION_A]. Somebody woke up with a new boss.
vox_Coup->New leader, same guards. Funny how that works.
vox_Coup->Coups are quick. The trouble afterwards is slow.
vox_Coup->One day you're in charge, the next you're in a cell. Politics.
vox_Coup->I bet the new lot promise everything. They always do.
vox_Revolution->A revolution! Statues coming down, flags going up.
vox_Revolution->Everything's going to change over there. For better or worse? Both.
vox_Revolution->Revolutions eat their own children, they say. I'd keep my distance.
vox_Revolution->When ordinary people rise up, somebody really pushed them too far.
vox_Revolution(TONE==sunny)->Good for them. Down with the bosses. Not ours, obviously.
vox_PowerStruggle->Too many people want the same chair.
vox_PowerStruggle->A power struggle. Lots of smiling and stabbing.
vox_PowerStruggle->Nobody's running [FACTION_A] properly right now. Good time to be a raider.
vox_SuccessionCrisis->Nobody knows who's in charge. That's never a calm situation.
vox_SuccessionCrisis->Two heirs, one throne. It's always one throne.
vox_Scandal->A scandal! Finally, something interesting in the paper.
vox_Scandal->Caught with their hand in the silver box. Classic.
vox_Scandal->Everyone's shocked. Nobody's surprised.
vox_OfficialDefects->Defected. Must have been a good offer.
vox_OfficialDefects->If their own people are leaving, something's rotten.
vox_ReformMovement->Reformers. Good luck, honestly.
vox_ReformMovement->Change from the inside. Slowest kind of change there is.
vox_SecessionMovement->They want out. Can't say I blame them.
vox_SecessionMovement->Breaking away. Maps are going to need redrawing.
vox_Emigration->People leaving [FACTION_A] in droves. That's a vote with your feet.
vox_Emigration->If they're fleeing, there must be something to flee from.
vox_Emigration->Refugees on the road. Some of them might end up here.
vox_PuppetInstalled->A puppet government. Strings and all.
vox_PuppetInstalled->They didn't conquer it, they just bought it a new head.
vox_PuppetFreed->Cut the strings. Good.
vox_PuppetFreed->Free again. Let's see what they do with it.
vox_AgentsExposed->Spies, caught. Somebody's in trouble.
vox_AgentsExposed->Exposed! I'd hate to be in that interrogation room.
vox_AgentsExposed->If they caught those spies, they've got better eyes than us.
vox_ForeignAgentsCaught->Caught spies in our midst. I knew that trader was too friendly.
vox_ForeignAgentsCaught->Who sends spies to a place like this? What are they after, our recipes?
vox_Assassination->Assassinated. That's not politics, that's murder with paperwork.
vox_Assassination->Somebody's very good at their job. Terrifying, but good.
vox_Assassination->If they can get to [LEADER_A], they can get to anyone.
vox_Assassination->I'm locking my door tonight. Both locks.
vox_Assassination->Blades in the dark. Nobody's safe at the top.
vox_Assassination(TONE==callous)->Clean. Professional. I'd tip my hat if I had one.
vox_Sabotage->Sabotage. Someone wanted that place to burn.
vox_Sabotage->Blown up in the night. Their factories will be quiet for a while.
vox_Sabotage->That's a week of nobody working over there. Maybe more.
vox_Sabotage->Sabotage is a coward's war. An effective coward's war.
vox_Sabotage->I'm checking our generators. Twice.
vox_FalseFlag->Somebody framed somebody. The truth's the first casualty.
vox_FalseFlag->Who really did it? I bet we'll never know.
vox_TechnologyStolen->Stolen secrets. Someone's going to have a nasty surprise in their next war.
vox_TechnologyStolen->Knowledge is the best loot. Can't be raided back.
vox_HostageRescued->Rescued! Somebody's a hero tonight.
vox_HostageRescued->In and out, without a scratch. I'd like to meet that team.
vox_ReligiousSchism->A schism. Two sides, both sure they're right.
vox_ReligiousSchism->Arguing about the gods. The gods are probably laughing.
vox_ReligiousSchism->Faith splits are the worst kind. Nobody backs down.
vox_CulturalFestival->A festival! Music, dancing, too much beer. I'm jealous.
vox_CulturalFestival->Finally some cheerful news.
vox_CulturalFestival->They're celebrating. Let's celebrate too. Any excuse.
vox_Famine->Famine in [FACTION_A]. We should count our blessings. And our pemmican.
vox_Famine->Empty bellies make for desperate neighbours.
vox_Famine->When food runs out, raids start. Lock the freezer.
vox_Famine->We should send something. Or at least not send raiders.
vox_Famine->I've been hungry before. It's not something you forget.
vox_Famine(TONE==greedy)->Hungry people pay well for food. Very well.
vox_Famine(TONE==kind)->We have spare rice. We should send it. We really should.
vox_PlagueOutbreak->Plague. Keep the visitors out of the dining room.
vox_PlagueOutbreak->Wash your hands. I'm serious. Everyone. Now.
vox_PlagueOutbreak->If any of their traders turn up coughing, I'm hiding in the freezer.
vox_PlagueOutbreak->Plague is the one enemy you can't shoot.
vox_PlagueOutbreak->Our doctor had better be ready. Is our doctor ready?
vox_PlagueOutbreak(TONE==grim)->Is it catching? It's catching, isn't it.
vox_NaturalDisaster->Nature reminding everyone who's really in charge.
vox_NaturalDisaster->Floods, quakes, fires. The planet doesn't care whose flag it is.
vox_NaturalDisaster->Hope they have good walls. And good shovels.
vox_NaturalDisaster->That could have been us. Next time it might be.
vox_Starvation->They're starving in [FACTION_A]. Actually starving.
vox_Starvation->When the stores run dry, everything else falls apart.
vox_Starvation->We should send food. Relief caravans make friends.
vox_Starvation->Starving neighbours become desperate neighbours. Then they become raiders.
vox_Starvation(TONE==greedy)->Desperate times, desperate prices. Ours.
vox_SettlementLooted->Looted. Everything not nailed down, and some things that were.
vox_SettlementLooted->They sacked [DETAIL]. Nothing left but ashes and angry people.
vox_SettlementLooted->Plunder. The oldest trade on the rim.
vox_PirateTheft->Pirates again. They raid everyone, even the ones who raid.
vox_PirateTheft->Their stores got cleaned out. Lock ours.
vox_PirateTheft->Someone's eating very well tonight, and it's not [FACTION_B].
vox_SettlementConstructionBegun->A new town going up. Somebody's optimistic.
vox_SettlementConstructionBegun->Settlers. Brave or foolish. Usually both.
vox_SettlementFounded->A new town on the map. More neighbours.
vox_SettlementFounded->They built a town. We built a slightly bigger freezer. We're even.
vox_ConstructionRaided->Attacked settlers before the walls were up. Nasty.
vox_ConstructionRaided->Hitting builders. Low, even for raiders.
vox_ConvoyLost->A whole convoy, gone. Somebody's very poor this morning.
vox_ConvoyLost->Trade routes aren't safe. Nothing's safe.
vox_ConvoyLost->Lost goods mean higher prices. Thanks, bandits.
vox_NewsCorrection->So it never happened? I spent a whole night worrying about that.
vox_NewsCorrection->Fake news. I knew it. I didn't know it, but I suspected it.
vox_NewsCorrection->A correction. The paper's admitting it was wrong? Mark the calendar.
vox_NewsCorrection->I'd like my worry back, please.
aside_WarDeclared->Recruiters were seen nailing posters to every tree in [CAPITAL_A].
aside_WarDeclared->Blacksmiths near the front report they have never been busier.
aside_WarDeclared->One soldier was overheard asking which side he was on.
aside_PeaceMade->Soldiers on both sides were seen sharing cigarettes within the hour.
aside_PeaceMade->The signing was delayed by an argument over the pen.
aside_Riots->The bakery was the first building looted. It always is.
aside_Riots->A goat was reportedly crowned leader of the rioters for about an hour.
aside_Coup->The old leader's portrait was replaced before the paint on the new one had dried.
aside_Coup->Palace guards were seen changing uniforms in a hurry.
aside_Famine->Rat prices in the markets have tripled.
aside_Famine->Some families have started eating insect jelly. Willingly.
aside_PlagueOutbreak->Healers are said to be running out of herbal medicine and patience.
aside_PlagueOutbreak->Masks made from old shirts are the season's fashion.
aside_Assassination->The guards insist they were on duty. Nobody believes them.
aside_Assassination->A single bootprint is the only clue so far.
aside_Sabotage->The fire could be seen from three hills away.
aside_Sabotage->Investigators found a suspicious amount of chemfuel residue.
aside_MissileStrike->Survivors describe a sound like the sky tearing.
aside_MissileStrike->The crater is reportedly still warm.
aside_SummitHeld->Both delegations brought their own food. Just in case.
aside_SummitHeld->The seating chart took longer to agree on than the agenda.
aside_LeaderDied->Flags flew at half-mast, mostly because nobody could reach the top.
aside_LeaderDied->Three people have already claimed to be the rightful heir.
